statement: Create new content in timeline markers with "Add Time Marker"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Run the data operation "Bind Camera to Markers" on the current selection in timeline markers; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.
Remove or clear content in timeline markers with "Delete Markers"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Copy content in timeline markers with "Duplicate Time Marker"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.
Copy content in timeline markers with "Copy Markers to Scene"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in timeline markers with "Move Time Marker"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in timeline markers with "Rename Marker"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
Change what is selected in timeline markers with "Select Time Marker"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.

Change what is selected in timeline markers with "(De)select all Markers"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
Change what is selected in timeline markers with "Marker Box Select"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.

Change what is selected in timeline markers with "Select Markers Before/After Current Frame"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.
